Title: Some users may encounter intermittent VDI2 optimization loss when using Microsoft Teams in a Citrix VDI environment

User impact: Users may encounter intermittent VDI2 optimization loss when using Microsoft Teams in a Citrix VDI environment.

More info: Users may experience audio and video quality degradation, and unavailability of certain features.

As a workaround, users can restart Teams to resolve the issue.

Current status: We're reviewing service monitoring telemetry to isolate the source of the issue and establish a fix.

Scope of impact: Some users who are attempting to utilize VDI2 optimization loss when using Microsoft Teams in a Citrix VDI environment may be impacted.

Next update by: Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at 5:30 PM UTC

Title: Some users may encounter intermittent VDI2 optimization loss when using Microsoft Teams in a Citrix VDI environment

Title: Some users may encounter intermittent VDI2 optimization loss when using Microsoft Teams in a Citrix VDI environment

User impact: Users may encounter intermittent VDI2 optimization loss when using Microsoft Teams in a Citrix VDI environment.

More info: Users may experience audio and video quality degradation, and unavailability of certain features.

As a workaround, users can restart Teams to resolve the issue.

Current status: We’ve identified that a recent configuration update to the VDI Bridge component responsible for VDI optimisation introduced a regression, resulting in impact. We’ve developed a fix and are currently validating it before deploying it to the affected infrastructure. We expect to provide a deployment timeline by our next scheduled update.

Scope of impact: Some users who are attempting to utilize VDI2 optimization loss when using Microsoft Teams in a Citrix VDI environment may be impacted.

Root cause: A recent configuration update to the VDI Bridge component responsible for VDI optimisation introduced a regression, resulting in impact.
